messages.content: Tuesday’s meeting is now confirmed to end at 4:30 p.m. Check the timing from the World Congress Center to the airport, and if the 8:45 return is comfortable, book that with the 7:00 a.m. outbound. Also verify the hotel is actually confirmed.

The Embassy Suites reservation is confirmed for one adult and one room, checking in Monday, April 13 and out Tuesday, April 14. The estimated total is $296 including taxes and mandatory fees, and the front desk will hold your luggage after checkout.

For Tuesday, the hotel is a short walk from the Georgia World Congress Center. Allow about 15 minutes after the meeting to retrieve your bag, then roughly 25 to 45 minutes by car to ATL depending on traffic. Leaving the hotel around 5:00 p.m. should put you at the airport between 5:25 and 5:45, about three hours before the 8:45 p.m. departure.
So even with heavier traffic, I’m not cutting it close?

No. Even if the drive takes an hour, you would reach ATL around 6:00 p.m., leaving about two hours and 45 minutes before departure. The 8:45 p.m. flight has materially more buffer than you need for a domestic departure.
Good. Remind me of the full flight schedule before you purchase it.

The itinerary is a Monday, April 13 nonstop from Chicago O’Hare to Atlanta, departing at 7:00 a.m. and arriving at 9:58 a.m. The return is Tuesday, April 14, nonstop from Atlanta to O’Hare, departing at 8:45 p.m. and arriving at 10:02 p.m. local time. It is for one adult in economy. Shall I complete that purchase?

The round-trip flights are confirmed for one adult in economy: O’Hare to Atlanta on Monday, April 13 at 7:00 a.m., arriving at 9:58 a.m.; Atlanta to O’Hare on Tuesday, April 14 at 8:45 p.m., arriving at 10:02 p.m. The Embassy Suites stay for April 13-14 remains confirmed at an estimated $296 total, with luggage storage available Tuesday. Your practical Tuesday plan is to retrieve your bag after the 4:30 meeting and leave for ATL around 5:00 p.m.
